mapper.insert: insert into biz_rebate_log (order_id, member_id, currency, amount, rebate_date, create_time) values (#{orderId}, #{memberId}, #{currency}, #{amount}, #{rebateDate}, sysdate())
mapper.select: select rebate_id as rebateId, order_id as orderId, member_id as memberId, currency, amount, rebate_date as rebateDate, create_time as createTime from biz_rebate_log where order_id = #{orderId} order by rebate_date desc, rebate_id desc
